introH2: ✈️ Staying Near Suvarnabhumi Airport — Which Type Suits Your Trip?
introHtml: Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) handles tens of millions of passengers a year, and dozens of hotels ring it across the Lat Krabang, Racha Thewa and Kingkaew zones. But not all of them suit a passenger who is connecting or flying out at dawn — the two factors that matter most are the real distance to the airport and a shuttle you can count on late at night. The hotels in this guide are grouped clearly by zone, from the in-airport hotel with a tunnel walkway that reaches the terminal in minutes, to the newest 4-star in Lat Krabang just 3km away, down to budget 3-star stays with free shuttles running 24 hours. This roundup covers 7 Suvarnabhumi-area hotels we've reviewed in depth — every one states the distance, shuttle, hours and the facts you need before you book. Real guest reviews cover both the good and the honest caveats, with prices compared across 3 platforms.
mrtHtml: Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) sits on the eastern side of Bangkok in Bang Phli, Samut Prakan. There are several ways in and out — the Airport Rail Link (ARL) Suvarnabhumi station is beneath the passenger terminal and runs to Phaya Thai station in around 30 minutes; a taxi from Sukhumvit takes 40–60 minutes depending on traffic. The hotels in this guide fall into two main zones — the Lat Krabang zone (~3km / ~8 minutes from the airport), home to Hyatt Regency, Courtyard by Marriott, Park Nine and Sinsuvarn, and the Racha Thewa–Kingkaew zone (~7–11km / ~15–20 minutes), home to Amaranth, Siam Mandarina and Cozy Blu. Every property offers a free or low-cost airport shuttle, which is the factor travellers prioritise most.

entries.name: Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport
entries.badge: 🏆 The only in-airport hotel · walk to the terminal
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Inside Suvarnabhumi Airport · tunnel walkway ~300m + free shuttle all day
entries.addr: 999 Moo 1, Bangna-Trad Road, Nong Prue, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan
entries.storyHtml: Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport is the only official hotel of Suvarnabhumi Airport — the building sits inside the airport grounds itself, with an underground tunnel walkway connecting straight to the passenger terminal in about 300 metres, plus a free shuttle all day. That is something no other hotel on this list can offer: no gambling on Bangna-Trad traffic at 4am, and no waiting for a transfer — something more than 1,000 real reviews agree makes a real difference on the day you're connecting or flying out before dawn. Another highlight is the flexible 24-hour check-in/check-out, and breakfast that opens at 3am. The honest caveat: the building has been open since 2006 and some rooms are starting to show their age — there are reviews that ran into dated furniture or a musty smell — and the price is noticeably higher than the hotels further out. If walking to the terminal isn't critical for you, stays ranked 2–3 give you better value for money.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a recently renovated room at the time of booking, and check the room before you set down your bags — if it's not right you can ask to switch, and staff usually sort it out fast.

entries.storyHtml: If you want an internationally recognised brand, a new room with no worries about its condition, and a reliable free shuttle — Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport, which opened in late 2023, fits the bill exactly. This 4-star Marriott property is just 3km from Suvarnabhumi, runs a free shuttle 24 hours a day (advance booking required), and ARL Lat Krabang station is about 4.4km away. It scores 9.1 on Booking.com from 1,414 reviews, with cleanliness at 9.5 — rooms are brand new, furniture is unmarked and there's no dated smell, which is rare among airport hotels. The caveat: it's pricier than Park Nine, which is in the same area and the same distance from the airport. If the Marriott brand isn't a must, the price difference is meaningful.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book the shuttle in advance by phone or email, and confirm the return leg with reception at check-in — some reviews note you have to ask before you get clear details.

entries.name: The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi
entries.badge: 💧 Saltwater canal-side pool · most reviews in the group
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Lat Krabang · ~3km / ~8 min by car to the airport · free shuttle every hour, 24 hours (Gate 5, Level 2)
entries.addr: 599-599/1 Lat Krabang Road, Lat Krabang, Bangkok 10520
entries.storyHtml: The Park Nine Hotel Suvarnabhumi is the best-balanced choice for anyone after an affordable 4-star in the Lat Krabang area — a hotel that opened in 2017, 3km from the airport, with a free shuttle running every hour, 24 hours a day, picking up at Gate 5, Level 2. It scores 8.9 from 2,405 reviews on Booking.com — more than any other 4-star hotel on this list, which tells you guests rebook and are genuinely happy. The highlight reviewers praise most is the outdoor saltwater pool beside a century-old canal, with a quiet, relaxed atmosphere that's surprising for a hotel this close to the airport. Prices start at ฿1,800/night, much cheaper than Courtyard for the same distance. The caveat: rooms on the Lat Krabang Road side can catch motorbike noise late at night — ask for a room facing the garden or canal instead.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The shuttle seats 8 and has on-board Wi-Fi — give your time in advance at reservation@theparknine.com or call +66 91 810 0730 to reserve a seat.
pros: Free shuttle every hour, 24 hours, 3km from the airport, consistently on time (per reviews)

entries.addr: 99 Moo 6, Kingkaew Road, Racha Thewa, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan 10540
entries.storyHtml: Siam Mandarina Hotel is not the closest stay to the airport on this list — it's about 11km away, 15–20 minutes by car — but it runs a free shuttle every hour, 24 hours a day, and what keeps it on the list is its 4,421 reviews on Booking.com, the most of all in this set. Its staff score is as high as 9.1, and breakfast opens at 4am, which is rare and ideal for an early-morning flight. There's a saltwater pool, the Chewasuk spa, a 24-hour gym, and free parking for 100 cars. The honest caveat: the building has been open since 1995 and parts have yet to be renovated — there are reviews that ran into dated bathrooms and lifts.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The inbound shuttle picks up at Exit 5 on Level 2, where staff hold a sign — no need to call ahead, but give your flight time at check-in so they can plan the return leg.

entries.addr: 68 Moo 2, Kingkaew Road, Rachathewa, Bangplee, Samut Prakan 10540
entries.storyHtml: Best Western Premier Amaranth Suvarnabhumi Airport is built specifically for travellers landing late or flying out at dawn — a 278-room, 4-star hotel 7km from the airport with a free shuttle every hour from 05:00 to 02:00 (advance booking required, meeting point at arrivals Gate 5, Exit B). What real reviews mention most is attentive staff who genuinely solve problems, especially on nights when flights are delayed. The Bua Chompoo restaurant is open 24 hours, and there's a pool, gym and Ma Spa. The caveat: the pool closes at 7pm, which you can miss if you arrive in the evening, and the balcony view from some rooms is of an industrial area.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Share your flight details in advance and confirm the shuttle run on your travel day — meet at arrivals Gate 5, Exit B, where staff wait holding a hotel name sign.

entries.storyHtml: Sinsuvarn Airport Suite is a budget 3-star option in the same Lat Krabang area as Courtyard and Park Nine, but at a much lower price — from just ฿900/night. Its main selling point is a free shuttle running 24 hours a day, 7km from the airport and 10–15 minutes away, which more than 1,800 real reviews praise for punctual, friendly staff. There's a pool, Thai massage and free parking — hard to find at this price. The caveat to know: the building has been open since 2009 and some rooms have dated furniture, and the lift stops between floors so you have to walk half a flight up or down — not convenient for older travellers or anyone hauling a lot of luggage.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Call ahead with your flight time and ask for a recently renovated room at the time of booking — reviews say staff sort things out fast if a room has issues.

entries.name: Cozy Blu Suvarnabhumi
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Racha Thewa, Bang Phli · ~10km / ~18 min by car to the airport · free shuttle 4 runs/day (departure) or ฿750/vehicle 24 hours
entries.addr: 71-72 Moo 9, Racha Thewa, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan 10540
entries.storyHtml: Cozy Blu Suvarnabhumi is the most budget-friendly option on this list, with a free breakfast buffet that reviews praise as more varied than expected — a 154-room, 3-star hotel in the Racha Thewa area, 10km from the airport, with prices from just ฿900/night. The free shuttle runs 4 times a day (roughly 08:30, 11:00, 14:00 and 16:00) and is departure-only; if you fly late or need a pickup from the airport, it's ฿750/vehicle, which is still much cheaper than Grab. The important caveat: there are reports of music from a neighbouring bar that carries throughout the day — if you're noise-sensitive, ask for a room on the side away from the bar, or pack earplugs.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The free shuttle is only 4 runs/day and departure-only — if you fly pre-dawn (before 08:30) you'll need to pay ฿750 for a private vehicle, and pick up any essentials at the airport first, since the surrounding area is remote.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions Travellers Ask About Staying Near Suvarnabhumi Airport

faq.q: ❓ Which hotels at Suvarnabhumi Airport let you walk straight to the terminal?
faq.a: There is only one: Hyatt Regency Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport — the only official hotel of Suvarnabhumi Airport, located inside the airport grounds itself, with an underground tunnel walkway connecting straight to the passenger terminal in about 300 metres, plus a free shuttle all day. It's the best fit for anyone with a tight connection, a pre-dawn flight, or a late landing who doesn't want to risk the traffic.

faq.q: ❓ Which hotels near Suvarnabhumi Airport offer a free shuttle 24 hours a day?
faq.a: Four hotels in this guide have a genuine 24-hour free shuttle: Hyatt Regency (walk + in-airport shuttle) · Courtyard by Marriott (advance booking required) · The Park Nine (every hour, no booking needed, but 8 seats) · and Sinsuvarn Airport Suite (24 hours, free both ways). Siam Mandarina and Amaranth run a free shuttle every hour but don't go as early as 5am, while Cozy Blu's free shuttle is departure-only, 4 runs a day.

faq.q: ❓ Which is the cheapest hotel near Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faq.a: The lowest starting prices are Sinsuvarn Airport Suite and Cozy Blu Suvarnabhumi, both from ฿900/night · Sinsuvarn is in the Lat Krabang zone, closer to the airport (~7km), with a free shuttle 24 hours · Cozy Blu is in Racha Thewa (~10km) but includes a free breakfast buffet, with a free shuttle only departure-only, 4 runs. If you're on a budget and flying midday, Cozy Blu is better value; if you fly late or need a pickup from the airport, Sinsuvarn suits better.

faq.q: ❓ How long does the shuttle from Suvarnabhumi Airport to the hotel take?
faq.a: It depends on the zone · Hyatt Regency is a ~300m tunnel walk or a few minutes by shuttle · Courtyard by Marriott and Park Nine are ~3km away, about 8 minutes · Amaranth is ~7km, 15–20 minutes · Sinsuvarn is ~7km, 10–15 minutes · Siam Mandarina is ~11km, 15–20 minutes · Cozy Blu is ~10km, ~18 minutes — it can take longer in heavy traffic.

faq.q: ❓ Which hotel is best for travellers with a pre-dawn flight at 5–6am?
faq.a: The three best fits are Hyatt Regency (walk to the terminal, no traffic gamble) · Siam Mandarina (breakfast from 4am, shuttle every hour) · and The Park Nine (free shuttle every hour, 24 hours, Gate 5, Level 2) · for a budget pick, choose Sinsuvarn, which also has a free shuttle around the clock, 24 hours.

faq.q: ❓ Are there hotels near both Suvarnabhumi Airport and the Airport Rail Link (ARL)?
faq.a: ARL Suvarnabhumi station is beneath the passenger terminal, about 30 minutes by train to Phaya Thai · for hotels in the Lat Krabang zone, ARL Lat Krabang station is about 4.4km from Courtyard by Marriott and about 4–5km from Park Nine and Sinsuvarn — these hotels can drop guests at ARL Lat Krabang station for an easy ride into the city.
